title: Amazon Black Friday Deals Are Live. Here’s What’s on Sale
gist: Shopping roundup of Amazon's 'Black Friday Week' sale (running to November 30). The few investable signals: Apple raised prices earlier in 2026 (MacBook Air now starts at $1,299, Black Friday discounts roughly restore pre-increase prices), gaming laptops became more expensive this year, and Google's Pixel 11 line hit record-low Amazon prices.

insights.claim: Apple raised prices earlier in 2026 so the MacBook Air (M5) now starts at about $1,300, and the $999 Black Friday price on Amazon only brings it back near its pre-increase level.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Apple's 2026 price hikes mean holiday discounts mostly offset increases rather than cut below historic price points; watch for unit-demand effects.
insights.quote: When Apple raised prices earlier this year, the once-affordable MacBook Air now starts at $1,300.
insights.locator: Best Amazon Black Friday Tech Deals

insights.claim: The base iPad (A16) Black Friday price of $379 brings it closer to its MSRP before Apple's 2026 price increase.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Confirms Apple's price increases spanned multiple product lines, not only Macs.
insights.locator: The best iPad for most people isn’t one of Apple’s more powerful options

insights.claim: Gaming laptops became even more expensive in 2026, with the Asus ROG Strix G16 RTX 5070 configuration near $3,000 and the RTX 5060 model discounted only 6% to $1,489.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Shallow discounts and rising gaming-laptop prices suggest component cost pressure in PC hardware.
insights.quote: Good gaming laptops are never cheap, and they’ve become even more expensive this year.

insights.claim: Google's Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are discounted 22-32% on Amazon to their lowest prices ever, and are the only non-iPhones supporting Qi2 magnetic charging compatible with MagSafe accessories.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Deep Pixel discounting signals Google pushing share in flagship Android via price.
insights.locator: GooglePixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL

insights.claim: Amazon's own devices are deeply discounted for Black Friday, with the Echo Show 11 at $155 (38% off) and the Blink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+ camera at $20 (60% off).
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Amazon continues to use hardware as a loss-leader-style funnel into the Alexa ecosystem.

insights.claim: Soundcore, the audio brand of Anker, is set to be rebranded as Anker, its parent company.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Minor brand consolidation at Anker; relevant only for consumer-electronics brand tracking.
insights.locator: Soundcore by AnkerBoom 2 Plus Portable Speaker
